tools.name: search_merchants
tools.description: Search KlickyMart merchant records (same filters as GET /q)

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Fetch one merchant record by domain

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Can my agent shop here? Verdict for one domain from the index (reachable, checkout-blocked, agents-not-welcome, blocked-tos, error, not-in-index; see verdict_reason and primary_reason), with checkout depth, pay methods, BTC grade, record time and evidence URL. Never triggers a live crawl.

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Product-level offers KlickyBot observed on store pages (schema.org JSON-LD or Shopify JSON): price, currency, stock, URL, checked_at. Match by gtin (UPC/EAN), mpn, or name words (q). Optional zip adds a landed-cost estimate; live=true also returns a live (uncached) Shopify Catalog search for q.

tools.name: get_landed_price
tools.description: One call: a product's landed price at a US ZIP. Searches KlickyMart-observed offers (and, with live=true, the live Shopify Catalog, never stored), and returns for every product: price, stock, url, checked_at, shipping (with source), est. tax with the rate used, est_total ONLY when price+shipping+tax

tools.name: get_checkout_map
tools.description: Checkout steps our probe reached for a store (stopping at the payment screen, never submitting), the first blocker (bot-wall, http-refusal, network-error, no-product-link, no-add-to-cart, form-gate, login-wall, robots, unclassified, none) and landed-cost signals.

tools.name: recheck_domain
tools.description: Re-read robots.txt and the home-page status for an indexed store now. Max 1 per store per 10 minutes (else cached result + next_allowed_at), 60 per hour overall.

tools.name: watch_item
tools.description: DRAFT (GO D8, not served yet): returns an unsigned kind 420 watch template for price/stock changes. KlickyMart does not act on watches yet and never signs for you.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain, find_offers, get_landed_price, get_reviews, submit_review, submit_store · Private data: search_merchants, get_record, check_domain, build_experience_note, submit_review, wallet_setup_guide · Public sink: build_experience_note, submit_review, submit_store.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain, find_offers, get_landed_price, get_reviews, submit_review, submit_store · Private data: search_merchants, get_record, check_domain, build_experience_note, submit_review, wallet_setup_guide · Public sink: build_experience_note, submit_review, submit_store

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
